::: {.callout-note}
**Editable Quarto edition.** The charts are the *same* ECharts components as
the [polished edition](article-explore.html) — assembled here in R with
`htmltools` from the data in `docs/article-data/`. Edit the `card(...)` calls
below and re-render with `quarto render article-explore.qmd`.
:::

```{r setup}
#| include: false
.libPaths(c(file.path(here::here(), "renv", "library", "linux-zorin-noble", "R-4.6"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(htmltools))

# Wrap the shared ECharts components in the Explore card markup.
card <- function(chart, data, title, sub = NULL, canvas = TRUE, var = NULL, bins = NULL) {
  attrs <- sprintf('data-chart="%s" data-data="article-data/%s"', chart, data)
  if (!is.null(var))  attrs <- paste(attrs, sprintf('data-var="%s"', var))
  if (!is.null(bins)) attrs <- paste(attrs, sprintf('data-bins="article-data/%s"', bins))
  cls <- if (canvas) ' class="x-canvas"' else ''
  sprintf(
    '<div class="x-card"><h3>%s</h3>%s<div%s %s></div></div>',
    title,
    if (is.null(sub)) "" else sprintf('<p class="x-sub">%s</p>', sub),
    cls, attrs
  )
}
grid2 <- function(...) sprintf('<div class="x-grid two">%s</div>', paste0(...))
```

## 01 · Data curation {#curation}

From every immunization dataset available, only a handful matched across species.

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(grid2(
  card("genusBar", "fig1-genus.json", "Datasets by genus"),
  card("sankey", "fig1-sankey.json", "From all datasets to the final cohorts")
))
cat(card("studiesTable", "fig1-studies.json", "Curated datasets",
         "20 per page · filter and sort", canvas = FALSE))
```

## 02 · Signal and noise {#conservation}

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(card("dgeFacets", "fig2-dge.json", "Significant genes by condition",
         "Human vs mouse — one panel per pathogen"))
cat(card("dgeScatter", "fig2-dge.json", "Noise vs effect size"))
```
